hook: THIS SHRIMP PUNCHES LIKE A BULLET
yt_title: Mantis Shrimp Punch: Fast As A Bullet? #Shorts
desc: A mantis shrimp strikes with the acceleration of a small bullet, reaching about twenty-three metres per second. Its eyes also have up to sixteen types of colour receptors. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: A tiny shrimp with a bullet punch! 🦐 Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a friend! Comment WOW

lines.text: This tiny shrimp punches with the acceleration of a bullet.
Its club moves at about twenty-three metres per second.
The strike is so fast it makes bubbles that collapse with a bang.
Its eyes are strange too. Humans have three colour receptor types.
Sixteen in a shrimp. So what does it punch with?
